UPDATE torn_stock_notice_audit t SET send_status = CASE WHEN COALESCE(t.send_attempt_count, 0) >= 3 THEN 'FAILED_FINAL' ELSE 'FAILED_RETRYABLE' END, rebalance_group_status = CASE WHEN COALESCE(t.send_attempt_count, 0) >= 3 THEN 'FAILED_FINAL' ELSE 'FAILED_RETRYABLE' END, rebalance_group_error = #{errorMessage}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, update_time = #{businessNow} WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.notice_type = 'ALPHA_REBALANCE' AND t.payload_snapshot ->> 'rebalanceAssociationId' = #{rebalanceAssociationId} AND t.claim_token = #{claimToken} AND t.send_status = 'SENDING' AND t.rebalance_group_status = 'SENDING' AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM torn_stock_notice_audit g WHERE g.deleted = 0 AND g.notice_type = 'ALPHA_REBALANCE' AND g.payload_snapshot ->> 'rebalanceAssociationId' = #{rebalanceAssociationId}) = 2 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM torn_stock_notice_audit g WHERE g.deleted = 0 AND g.notice_type = 'ALPHA_REBALANCE' AND g.payload_snapshot ->> 'rebalanceAssociationId' = #{rebalanceAssociationId} AND g.claim_token = #{claimToken} AND g.send_status = 'SENDING' AND g.rebalance_group_status = 'SENDING') = 2 AND (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(g.send_attempt_count, 0)) FROM torn_stock_notice_audit g WHERE g.deleted = 0 AND g.notice_type = 'ALPHA_REBALANCE' AND g.payload_snapshot ->> 'rebalanceAssociationId' = #{rebalanceAssociationId} AND g.claim_token = #{claimToken} AND g.send_status = 'SENDING') = 1

UPDATE torn_stock_notice_audit t SET send_status = CASE WHEN t.send_status = 'SENT' THEN 'SENT' ELSE 'FAILED_FINAL' END, rebalance_group_status = #{groupStatus}, rebalance_group_error = #{groupError}, error_message = CASE WHEN t.send_status = 'SENT' THEN t.error_message ELSE #{groupError} END, update_time = #{businessNow} WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.notice_type = 'ALPHA_REBALANCE' AND t.payload_snapshot ->> 'rebalanceAssociationId' = #{rebalanceAssociationId} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM torn_stock_notice_audit g WHERE g.deleted = 0 AND g.notice_type = 'ALPHA_REBALANCE' AND g.payload_snapshot ->> 'rebalanceAssociationId' = #{rebalanceAssociationId} AND g.rebalance_group_status = 'SENT' )
